## The purpose of this document is for the week 09 assignment on factoring the intertidal data.

1\) Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
```

2\) Load data

```{r}
#| message: false

intertidal <- read_csv(here("week_09", "data", "intertidaldata.csv")) |>
  clean_names() #make column names lowercase & look the same

intertidal_lat <- read_csv(here("week_09", "data", "intertidaldata_latitude.csv"))
```

3\) Data Analysis

I want to sum up the counts of the whelks, crabs, and stars by their site and quadrant

```{r}

counts <- intertidal|>
  group_by(quadrat) |>
  summarise(count_stars = sum(stars_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            count_whelks = sum(whelks_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            count_crabs = sum(crabs_counts, na.rm = TRUE))

head(counts)
```

There are 2 rows that seem like it was error with naming conventions in the observation, plus values were 0's therefore will be removing.

```{r}
#row 3, quadrat says "Low ." 
#row 5, quadrat saya "Mid 1"
counts <- counts[-c(3, 5), ]
```

The data is in wide format, I want it to be in long format and factor based on quadrat (Low –\> High tide).

```{r}
counts_long <- counts |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(count_crabs, count_whelks, count_stars),
    names_to = "type_of_organism",
    values_to = "count",
    names_prefix = "count_") |> #removes portion of the string for new obs. 
  group_by(quadrat, type_of_organism) |>
           summarise(total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(quadrat = factor(quadrat, levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))) |>
  mutate(type_of_organism = fct_recode(type_of_organism, #used for plotting
                                       "Crabs" = "crabs",
                                       "Stars" = "stars",
                                       "Whelks" = "whelks"))
```

Plotting

```{r}
ggplot(counts_long, aes(x = quadrat, y = total_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  facet_wrap(~type_of_organism, scales = "free_y") + 
  #original scale was in the whelks count which was too high for stars/ crabs
  labs(title = "Total Count of Different Organisms by Tide Height",
       x = "Tide Height",
       y = "Count")  +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) 

ggsave(here("week_09", "outputs", "plot.png"))
```
